_about: H9 The boing (docs/modes/clinic-design.md Q4 H9; contract docs/clinic-heal-api.md). The doctor holds the syringe (the child hands it to him; the child never touches it). Wipe the arm the count of times, count DOWN aloud with the doctor (a speaking moment: shared Say.moment, pills as the fallback, a grown-up's tick), boing, then the plaster and the lollipop in the called order. Blind level 1: 1/3 (wipe count) x 1/4 (the next number) x 1/2 (the order).

1.note: One arm, sleeve up. Wipe ba/trae/char times, count down from ba, then the plaster and the lollipop in the called order.

2.note: Both sleeves up: the patient says which arm (their own left or right). Count down from trae.

3.note: Count down from panj; the plaster's colour from three.
